prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: six development-card ARTWORK illustrations in one game-art atlas.
Input images: terrain-painted.png and sprites-painted.png are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY. Generate brand-new card illustrations. Do not edit or reproduce the terrain or sprite atlases. Match their refined soft natural hand-painted gouache, visible human brushwork, matte pigment, restrained palette and tactile miniature-storybook quality.
Layout is critical: ONE SQUARE CANVAS, request exactly 1536 by 1536 pixels. Exactly THREE equal columns and TWO equal rows, no gutters or borders. Each of the SIX cells is a tall 2:3 PORTRAIT rectangle, 512 pixels wide by 768 pixels tall. Sharp cell boundaries at x=512 and x=1024, y=768. Every cell is completely filled by its own portrait card artwork, edge to edge. The full atlas is square, not landscape.
Six cells, exact row-major order:
TOP LEFT — Knight artwork: a friendly heroic adult harbor watch guard, warm trustworthy expression, practical modest armor, muted sage cloak, standing watch above a welcoming island harbor. Rich forest/sage palette, well-composed portrait silhouette, softly painted face. Calm strength and guardianship, no combat or menace.
TOP MIDDLE — Road Building artwork: a winding newly built path crossing a handsome timber footbridge, a few friendly adult builders setting stones and carrying boards, island terrain beyond. Distinct slate/teal palette, winding path guides the eye upward through the portrait, believable wood and stone.
TOP RIGHT — Year of Plenty artwork: generous harvest-market baskets and crates overflowing with golden hay, grain, vegetables and mixed natural resources such as timber logs and clay, warm abundance in a small sunny island market. Distinct straw-gold palette, clear generous foreground still life, medium detail.
BOTTOM LEFT — Monopoly artwork: an influential merchant's large BLANK cream trade charter, a prominent deep burgundy wax seal, and gathered resource cargo of timber, clay, grain, wool and stone around the parchment. A tasteful trade desk/cargo composition suggesting strong trading influence. Burgundy and parchment-gold palette. The parchment has NO writing, letters, numbers, drawn pseudo-writing or marks; the wax seal is generic and unlettered.
BOTTOM MIDDLE — Victory Point artwork: a beautiful grand council hall in a thriving island town, cream stone, warm brass roof accents, soft banners without writing, broad welcoming steps, tasteful civic splendor and small human scale. Distinct cream/brass palette, main building is the clear focal point, original refined storybook architecture.
BOTTOM RIGHT — Card back artwork: a restrained elegant repeating compass-and-leaf heraldic pattern on soft deep navy paper, subtle muted antique-gold line and gouache detail, rotationally balanced, classy and quiet, one simple central generic compass rose surrounded by sparse leaf motifs. Original unbranded pattern.
Style and composition: rich tasteful traditional gouache illustration, experienced human-illustrator feel, matte paper and natural brush texture, refined storybook fantasy, soft diffuse daylight, restrained saturation and gentle contrast, detailed but composed rather than busy. Each portrait artwork has a strong focal point and remains recognizably different at 100 pixels wide. Confident organic brush strokes and well-observed natural materials. Maintain one cohesive illustration family while clearly distinguishing each card palette.
Constraints: ART ONLY, no written text, lettering, numbers, labels, title bars, UI, watermarks, logos or official Catan symbols. No brand imitation, no glossy CGI, no plastic faces, no oversaturated busy decoration, no thick card border, no gutter, no spacing between cells. No labels inside the image. Keep exact 3-column by 2-row grid on a square sheet, with six tall 2:3 portrait illustrations.
